goon.contact.notice_clerk.name: Nora Reed
goon.contact.notice_clerk.personality: Precise about her ledger, less impressed by queue jumping.
goon.contact.notice_clerk.need: Find which obsolete notices still send residents to the wrong day.
goon.contact.notice_clerk.knowledge: Her delivery ledger, statements actually supplied to her, and her own correction orders.

goon.contact.notice_neighbor.name: Sam Ortega
goon.contact.notice_neighbor.personality: Helpful, hurried, and sometimes working from yesterday's handbill.
goon.contact.notice_neighbor.need: Keep the tenant group from missing its delivery.
goon.contact.notice_neighbor.knowledge: His handbill, conversations with him, and corrections delivered to the tenant group.

compare.title: A second report
compare.speaker: Your incident journal
compare.situation: A posted date and a resident's handbill may disagree. Neither is the dispatch ledger.

options.label: Read the shop board
options.tradeoff: Visit p032. Learn that source's current claim, not an automatically correct answer.

options.label: Ask Sam about the handbill
options.tradeoff: Visit n13. Hear the tenant group's current report and its limitations.

verify.title: Check an accountable source
verify.speaker: Nora Reed
verify.situation: Nora can show the local delivery ledger once it is available. It covers this delivery only.

options.label: Verify against the delivery ledger
options.tradeoff: One action at n13; no wage. Learn the authenticated date and whether a lawful standby slot exists.

response.title: Whom do you help?
response.speaker: Your incident journal
response.situation: Correcting one channel does not magically inform the others. Refusal creates no promise or debt.

options.label: Post a signed, verified correction
options.tradeoff: At p032. Corrects the board only; the tenant group may still follow its old handbill.

options.label: Notify Nora of the conflicting notice
options.tradeoff: At n13 with verified findings. Nora orders a board correction for the next day; residents still need their own warning.

options.label: Pass on the unchecked posted date
options.tradeoff: At n13. Saves verification effort but explicitly risks misleading Sam's group. No payment or invented legal guilt.

options.label: Take a lawful standby slot for yourself
options.tradeoff: At n13 after observing the poster and verifying a vacancy. Disclose the discrepancy but request its freed slot instead of a correction order: Nora standing -1. Opens one optional $5 shift, not an immediate reward.

options.label: Refuse involvement
options.tradeoff: No debt or penalty. Independent correction still proceeds.

repair.title: The other audience
repair.speaker: Sam Ortega
repair.situation: A private warning reaches Sam's group, not the shop board. A retraction removes a bad claim without a trust-farming reward.

options.label: Deliver the verified date to Sam's group
options.tradeoff: At n13 after checking the ledger. Corrects only the tenant group; a timely warning can prevent a missed delivery.

options.label: Retract your unchecked date
options.tradeoff: At n13 with verified findings. Corrects your recipients, avoids later blame, earns no bonus.

aftermath.title: Read the final circular
aftermath.speaker: Your incident journal
aftermath.situation: An authenticated final circular is available locally after independent resolution. Your old journal does not update itself.

options.label: Read the issued correction
options.tradeoff: At n13. Learn the final source once; no wage, relationship reward or allowance refresh.

followup.title: The reserved standby shift
followup.speaker: Nora Reed
followup.situation: Only an actually reserved vacancy opens this small lawful shift. It is optional and expires.

options.label: Work the reserved standby shift
options.tradeoff: At n13, after resolution. $5 once; no repeat reservation or automatic employer membership.
